title: Glass cards
description: Frosted-glass UI cards over a photo or video (real backdrop blur), entering in depth with a stagger; the pointer clicks one card's toggle on and a check pops. A headline can sit above. The SaaS promo look. Give `background` (a bin file id) for the glass to blur; without one a soft sky gradient is drawn.

background.description: Photo or video behind the glass (file id).

headline.description: Headline above the cards; *words* in stars get the serif italic (empty: none).

click.description: Which card the pointer switches on (0-based; -1: no pointer).

status.description: What the clicked card's second line becomes.
